//: The ONE file to configure. Made by `python v2.py new <Name> --repo <path> --test "<cmd>"` (or copy this folder by hand). Then write issues.yaml, `v2.py check`, `v2.py issues`, `v2.py run`. Relative paths resolve next to this file; CLI flags override any value here.
repo: TODO: absolute path to the project's git checkout
//agent: A builtin name (codex, claude, aider) or a sidecar agent file like agent.json. model blank = the agent's own default.
//branching: Solo defaults: work on the checked-out non-base branch, else on work_branch. Base merges in automatically (aborts on conflict). Issues close when the PR merges.

run.//: Issue filters for this run. Push/PR stay manual: review the branch, push it, open one PR.

adversary.//: Veto-only reviewer (adversary.py), the last gate in validate.json. Needs GEMINI_API_KEY; without it every review is logged UNREVIEWED and nothing is blocked. Set enabled false to turn it off.

scope.//: Deterministic scope gate (integrity/integrity.py gate) records which changes fall outside the issue's **Scope:** line. Keep report mode: a study of 232 past commits found most out-of-scope changes were legitimate ripple effects or doc updates. Tests, docs and .env.example are allowed by default; agent config (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .claude/, .mcp.json) and *.bak files are always flagged unless scoped. Override with allow_globs / protect_globs.

refs.//: Dangling reference check (integrity/integrity.py refs): fails when a change removes a function, class or constant that other code still uses. Needs no scope. Enforced: on 232 past commits it flagged 5, all real breakages the tests missed. Add false alarms to ignore: [...]; set mode to report to only record.
